PRICING

You pay for active subscribers. Not seats. Not modules. Not surprises.

Transparent pricing that grows with you. No guesswork. Just tools that simplify operations and drive ROI, priced against your actual subscriber count.

Why Sonar

What you only get here. Read them before you compare.

01

Operator pedigree

Built for ISPs since 2015.

Sonar has only ever served broadband. Not a SaaS that pivoted into the industry. The platform was built around the way operators actually run their networks.

02

Support depth

Real humans. In-house. Not outsourced.

A North America-based support team that knows the product end to end. No scripts. No bots. You talk to the people who build and maintain Sonar.

03

Proven at scale

385+ broadband providers and counting.

More than 385 broadband providers across the US and Canada run on Sonar. The path to moving an operator onto Sonar is tested, not theoretical.

04

Built for consolidation

40+ mergers and acquisitions handled.

More than 40 M&A-related transitions folded into live production in the past 18 months. When you consolidate or get acquired, Sonar is the team that has run that play.
